status: R1 filed for the live QR/ICS ticket send integration on the staging line. The migration adds the one-send guard column and Directus field metadata; the route sends the Flow-triggered email with a CID QR and .ics attachment. CTO approved the AFC-1250 email/QR/ICS direction; the landing commit carries Reviewed-by: MediaTech (CTO).
whatTheChangeActuallyDoes: Adds event_registrations.ticket_email_sent_at (hidden field metadata) for one-send-per-registration. Adds a Flow-triggered POST /api/tickets/flow-send protected by NUXT_TICKET_FLOW_SECRET: reads the stored row, builds the raw ticket_code QR PNG and the event-derived .ics, sends via SMTP (QR inline CID, .ics attachment, sender YDD Lagos North), then stamps ticket_email_sent_at. Adds public QR PNG and .ics endpoints. The Directus Flow is switched to call the route after ticket_code assignment.
scopeOfTheClaim: R1 only. Live staging change; no production deploy. Test registration rows cleaned after verification. The WhatsApp channel remains outside this slice.
